iti100:2.1: Aham-asmi bhikkhave brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadhāro anuttaro bhisakko sallakatto.
iti100:2.2: Tassa me tumhe puttā orasā mukhato jātā dhammajā dhammanimmitā dhammadāyādā no āmisadāyādā.
iti100:3.3: etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ dānānaṃ yad-idaṃ dhammadānaṃ.
iti100:4.3: etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ saṃvibhāgānaṃ yad-idaṃ dhammasaṃvibhāgo.
iti100:5.3: etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ anuggahānaṃ yad-idaṃ dhammānuggaho.
iti100:6.3: etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ yāgānaṃ yad-idaṃ dhammayāgo ti.
iti100:8.1: Ayam--pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||1|| 101. (Cat.2) *
